meta_data.base_class: Diagnose the cause of increased noise in <home appliances> and provide solutions - refers to various electronic or electrical devices that generate sound during operation.

tool_template.name: Diagnose_<class>_Noise
tool_template.description: Diagnose the cause of increased noise in <class> and suggest solutions.

noise_level.description: Description of the noise level and type (e.g., humming, rattling) in the <class>.

include_diy_solutions.description: Whether to include DIY solutions for noise reduction in the <class>.

ambient_temperature.description: The ambient operating temperature in degrees Celsius of the <class> environment, as temperature can affect noise generation.

operating_duration.description: The duration in minutes for which the <class> has been operating continuously, as prolonged use can impact noise levels.

maintenance_history.description: Historical maintenance details of the <class>, which may influence the source or nature of noise.

installation_quality.description: A description of the quality or thoroughness of the installation of the <class>, as improper installation may lead to increased noise.

usage_frequency.description: The frequency of use per week of the <class>, as more frequent use might lead to wear and increased noise.
